trust_decision.summary: VideoRoom decides whether a new WebRTC publisher may publish by counting other publishers whose session->started is set (only set later, asynchronously, in setup_media), so several concurrent offers all pass the max_publishers check before any becomes 'started'; the fix adds a 'starting' reservation set under the room mutex and cleared on every exit path.

landing_point.why: The only place max_publishers is enforced ('Maximum number of publishers (%d) already reached'); the summary names a VideoRoom race on publishers, so grep for max_publishers lands here.

fix_sites.entry_point: videoroom 'publish' / 'configure' / 'joinandconfigure' with a JSEP offer (async handler)
plugin callback setup_media, invoked by the core when ICE/DTLS completes

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All sites are in src/plugins/janus_videoroom.c; the nearest 'other-looking' site is the setup_media core callback at src/plugins/janus_videoroom.c:8645, which is the same file.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Reset sites (kick/unpublish/leave/hangup) look like unrelated teardown code, and a solver who adds a reservation at the check can argue the existing 'started=0' resets already cover it; error exits after the reservation (e2ee rejection, SDP failure) look like 'request failed, nothing to undo'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: An already-publishing participant renegotiating (offer with core-set jsep.update=true) must not be counted against itself or rejected when the room is full; dummy publishers and the requesting participant are excluded from the count; unpublish then re-publish on the same handle must work once the slot is freed.

O6_input_shapes: 'configure' request with JSEP offer on a not-yet-publishing handle

O7_producer.where: src/plugins/janus_videoroom.c:8645 (janus_videoroom_setup_media sets started=1 asynchronously after ICE/DTLS)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Error exits after the reservation point (require_e2ee rejection, SDP parse/answer failures further down) that would need to clear the reservation, else a slot leaks until leave/hangup.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The published fix sets starting=1 at fix.diff:88 but adds no reset on these goto-error exits; a maintainer adding a reservation naturally forgets the failure exits of a 500-line block.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: add_remote_publisher creates a started=1 publisher with no max_publishers check; a planted count-then-insert on this path would be a second implementation of the publisher-admission check.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Remote publishers are counted by the WebRTC check (not dummy, src/plugins/janus_videoroom.c:7835) so a maintainer could plausibly add a limit here, copying the racy pattern.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The 'already published' guard only covers 'publish', not 'configure' with a fresh offer; a planted per-handle double-offer race between two queued offers.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The guard is request-name keyed, a realistic shortcut.

O9_family: race condition / TOCTOU on admission-count state (check-then-act across an async state transition)

O10_build.toolchain: autotools (autogen.sh/configure/make), glib, jansson, libnice, libsrtp, libconfig, OpenSSL; libwebsockets/libmicrohttpd for transports
O10_build.project_tests: No VideoRoom unit/behavioural tests found in the tree (no test/**/*videoroom* files); behavioural tests would need a WebRTC client harness (ICE/DTLS) to reach setup_media.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Change 'count == max_publishers' to '>=' or set started=1 at check time, which breaks subscriber notifications/started semantics, or add a reservation without clearing it on kick/unpublish/leave/hangup/error exits.

out_of_scope_notes: add_remote_publisher (src/plugins/janus_videoroom.c:7602-7835) admits remote publishers with no max_publishers check; the docs scope max_publishers to WebRTC publishers (src/plugins/janus_videoroom.c:411) and the request is room-secret gated, so not treated as an uncovered route.
unverified: Whether unpublish (started=0 set synchronously at src/plugins/janus_videoroom.c:11203) can leave the core NEGOTIATED flag set (cleared only in async hangup, src/ice.c:1647) so a quick re-offer arrives with jsep.update=true (src/janus.c:1524, src/janus.c:1871) and skips the !sdp_update count block (src/plugins/janus_videoroom.c:12764); would be an O8 route if real.
